train_sources: material_expansion_v1 (all48 newly declared synthetic cases; unknown labels excluded, never relabeled)
test_source: material_pilot_v1a all36 previously inspected published-model/table tasks;32 known labels and4 unknown; no test labels used to fit
baseline_model: Frozen predictor_pilot_v1/outputs/fold_models/strict_source_component-0.json trained only on original12 synthetic cases; verify its training IDs before reuse
algorithm: Reuse exact frozen208-feature extraction, joint128-tree forest parameters and JSON export; no hyperparameter, feature, task or budget changes after results
additional_control: Same-family training-label sample closest in L1 distance to coordinate-wise median of joint log1p(N),log1p(D/lambda_ref); same pair, not strict medoid; test labels not used
metrics: Same held36 task predictions for old and augmented forest and training-only representative baselines
N MAE ceil and float, positive D MAPE, either-resource underestimation, by-family, known-label fraction and feature envelope
Unknown cases remain unscored; no calibration or confidence interval
stopping_rule: Run every declared expansion case to terminal recorded state, preserve all results including unknown; one fixed fit and comparison, do not resample curves or tune to the held set
scope: Posthoc same-target material-transfer diagnostic, not blind test or independent field validation; old literature results and their input domain were inspected before this design
